series_class: derived plan proxy; not actual tariff or CPI
derivation: For each calendar year, reset prior_cap_pct to 0 in January. For each month in an explicitly published cap interval, rate_pct = ((1 + cap_pct / 100) / (1 + prior_cap_pct / 100) - 1) * 100; carry the interval's cap_pct forward to the next month. Round to six decimal places. This measures change in the published cumulative legal payment ceiling only.
